title: ThePrimeagen on leaving Netflix, sticking with hard things, and not chasing metrics
summary: In a casual livestream interview, ThePrimeagen explains why he ignores view counts, how he pushes through frustrating tools like Zig, why he debugs with print statements, how he got into Vim, and why he left Netflix for full-time content. Mixes craft advice with life perspective and ergonomics.

principles.text: Make content because you enjoy it and ignore the numbers; every milestone becomes a moving goalpost.
principles.quote: I need to make stuff because I really enjoy it and then just let it out there and see what happens right now and that's like that's it to try not to like try not to get too wrapped up
